summary: The Lord commands Balaam to bless Israel—He does so, saying, Who can count the dust of Jacob? and, What hath God wrought!
meta_description: The Lord commands Balaam to bless Israel—He does so, saying, Who can count the dust of Jacob? and, What hath God wrought!

footnotes.note19_b: Ex. 32:14; Deut. 32:36; Isa. 31:2; Amos 7:3 (3, 6). TG God, Perfection of.
